 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bryophyta - Moss:**

 
 
• Bryophyta is the scientific name for the group of plants commonly known as mosses.
 
• Mosses are non-vascular plants that lack true roots, stems, and leaves. They reproduce through spores and play important roles in ecosystems, particularly in retaining moisture and contributing to soil formation.
